description: Painter's own Unreal Engine (Packed) export of the Tier 1 pilot phase2/tier1/tunic-v10-current (phase3.2_unreal-ue56-packed-preset item 3.1). Every input, the create and the sync are the admitted phase2/tier1/tunic-v10-current golden's, byte for byte, run with the same recorder adaptations. The configuration replaces the five-map export configuration as the native job's one closing export. The authored configuration export-config.json names Painter's starter-assets preset by the versioned URL R-322 observed (decision 322) for the texture set DefaultMaterial, with the pilot's own export parameters: PNG 16, sizeLog2 12, infinite padding, no dithering, no shader parameters. Recordings: r1 (same session), r1-repeat (same session, every export again) and r2 (after save, close and reopen, every export again). No packing or value is presumed.
